title: Field-window actual-Q3 multiplication-word majorant
question: On a declared bounded field window, do the actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potential differences admit a two-orientation entire multiplication-word envelope?

model.local_choices: one onsite plus three Q3 edges plus six spatial bonds
model.word_bound: B(Q,S)^n for length-n coefficient words; factorial EGF exp(t*B(Q,S))
model.coefficient_norm: sum of absolute source coefficients times S^degree

scoped_verdict: For fixed Q and S, the exact field-dependent source coefficient tables obey the displayed triangle bounds. Summing one onsite, three Q3-edge and six spatial-bond choices gives B(Q,S); the length-n coefficient-word envelope is B(Q,S)^n and the factorial generating envelope is exp(t*B(Q,S)). Endpoint reversal has the same bound.

adversarial_review.check: The bound is uniform only for |field|<=Q; Q is not removed or replaced by an energy operator.
The multiplication-word norm is a scalar polynomial coefficient norm and does not prove unbounded operator-domain control or Duhamel dynamics.
Ten is the local bounded-degree envelope; it is not a support-growth or first-passage theorem.
Reversal preserves the absolute coefficient bound but is not an adjoint-history identity.
B(Q,S) grows cubically in Q for fixed S, so this result cannot be promoted to a field-independent norm without a separate energy/state mechanism.
R222 checks exact rational fixture arithmetic only.
No thermodynamic QFT dynamics, OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

scope.closed: Field-window coefficient-level entire envelope for the actual local Q3 potential differences and both endpoint orientations.
scope.not_closed: Energy-weighted or state-weighted removal of Q, operator commutator/Duhamel histories, spatial first-passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Use the explicit Q-dependence to test a radius-loss or energy/state-weighted replacement; only a bound with Q absorbed by a declared common-core topology can enter the actual two-orientation first-passage gate.
no_overclaim: This package proves only a bounded-field coefficient envelope. It does not prove the Q3 real-time history, thermodynamic QFT dynamics, common alpha, KMS, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
